question: Does the frozen whole-image advantage for assembly status persist among photos with comparable scene presentation?
hypothesis: DINOv3 whole-image scores retain higher AUROC than region-family scores within photographs showing environmental or handling context, rather than only separating isolated product pictures from scene photographs.
design: Post-hoc observational diagnostic on all 48 previously evaluated photos. No refitting, threshold search, new extraction or relabeling of assembly outcomes. Style judged from original images before joining frozen scores; same agent has prior exposure to cohort, so this is not independent blinding.

presentation_codes.scene: Visible physical surroundings, hand, work surface texture, shelf, floor, container or pile of objects photographed together. A watermark does not change this code.
presentation_codes.isolated: One or more products or assemblies isolated against uniform/background-removed presentation, without visible handling or environmental setting. This takes precedence over scene for white-background arrangements of several objects.
presentation_codes.composite: Clearly assembled montage, diagram or illustration with discontinuous placements or graphic rendering.
presentation_codes.uncertain: Insufficient context to distinguish the preceding types.

primary: Paired difference in AUROC, whole-image DINOv3 minus region-family score, in the scene stratum; do not merge strata after looking at scores.
secondary: AUROC of all frozen comparators within each estimable stratum
Pooled conditional AUROC using positive-negative pairs only within the same presentation stratum
Resolution sensitivity within scene photographs at minimum native side >=150 pixels; report unestimable groups explicitly
Group-balanced metrics after visually confirmed test-scene duplicates are assigned one representative chosen by lexicographically first source SHA256, independent of outcome and scores
clarification_before_score_join: After reviewing images, clarified that isolated white-background arrangements may contain several products. Added visual scene grouping after observing repeated crops and watermark variants in the review sheets; this grouping is explicitly adaptive and is not source-independent validation.
uncertainty: 10000 paired stratified bootstrap draws, resampling positives and negatives separately within each presentation stratum; same draws for all models. No formal causal or source-independence claim.
compute: Light CPU on 48 frozen prediction rows; original-image visual review. No model inference or training, no paid compute.
adaptive_source_review_extension: All 130 development originals screened against all 48 test originals. Four candidates compared side-by-side, one unresolved because of blur; report exclusion sensitivity without changing the primary cohort or frozen scores.
